label: PF Backlog 558
title: Graceful orphan/stuck recovery: reap expired+stuck assignments, clean worktrees, wg recover
body:
## Why
An aborted/stuck worker left an orphaned lease AND a stale worktree/branch requiring manual cleanup; recovery was
expiry-only (~1h) and never removed worktrees.

## What
- job_manager: renew_lease/claim set execution.last_heartbeat_at; recover_expired also reaps STUCK assignments
  (no heartbeat > PF_STUCK_MINUTES, default 15), keeps REQUIRE_REVIEW default; release/fail/recover remove the
  assignment worktree (branch kept) via vcs.remove_worktree.
- backlog._default_execution: + last_heartbeat_at.
- wg recover verb -> POST /engineering/assignments/recover.
- workergrid/config.json: agent.timeout_seconds 1800 (bound hung runs).

## Verify
- test_recover_reaps_stuck_assignment (stale heartbeat -> blocked, lease cleared).
- 20 tests pass; wg_surface_check OK.
